local_policies.wisp: Count active living controlled battlefield minions by current face in the complete seven-member fixed raw tag-3881 family, regardless of executable coverage, silence, or printed stats. Gain 1 plus their count. No same-name inference, no filtering by standard/root membership. Internal matching/amount policy awaits M6.
local_policies.original_hand_cost: Capture both physical hands and their current face printed costs at original battlecry execution; ordinary local set-cost contributions, ongoing public layers remain ordinary. Stale original CardReference is skipped.
local_policies.one_cost_history: Each actual committed own MINION hand play whose frozen submitted card ID has printed cost 1; duplicates and countered plays count, current source changes and paid discounts do not redefine printed cost. Each becomes an ordinary fresh base summon without Battlecry. Original order; M6 policy.
local_policies.overheat_targets: Capture the initial friendly living minion residences once; the same originals receive the second +1/+1 only after actual random Nature discard success. No later arrivals or same-ID reentry.
local_policies.excess: max(0, original DamageResult.damage_dealt - max(0, original health_before)); normal Draw, fatigue and burn.
local_policies.shellnado: Consume actual min(5,armor) once via LoseArmor; execute that many separate current-board 1-point SPELL DamageBatch pulses using ordinary spell power and reactions.
local_policies.spell_damage_history: Use spell_damage_dealt original captured SPELL attribution on effective current turn; CopyMinion current original board presence and normal summon cause.
local_policies.harbinger: Repeated physical HAND listener only for its own actual card_returned event tied to latest HandEntryRecord from BOARD/reason return and matching controller/epoch; normal count-two random 2-cost board generation.
